result.description:
About the company

Statewide Bearings is a proudly 100% Australian-owned and operated family business, with over 50 years of expertise in the bearing and power transmission industry. As one Australia’s leading suppliers in this field, we have offices located across the country, with more than 44 locations and a team of over 500 employees nationwide. As a family owned and operated business we are committed to our people. At SWB, we prioritise our employees, promoting a supportive and inclusive work environment where every team member feels valued and has the opportunity to grow.

About the role

We are currently seeking a motivated Sales Representative to join our Statewide Bearings team Wind Energy Team in Dandenong!
In your role, you will be responsible for supporting growth of our Wind Energy division by delivering technical service solutions, undertaking maintenance activities both in the workshop and at third-party sites, providing engineering support, and coordinating workshop and onsite service activities, while providing an exceptional level of customer service and satisfaction to all SWB customers and internal stakeholders.
This is a full-time position that offers excellent career prospects working alongside a highly motivated team. As a Sales Representative, you will report to the Wind Energy Manager and work closely with our Wind Energy Team.

About the Position

Position: Sales Representative (Industrial Products)

Location of work: 84 Greens Road, Dandenong South, VIC 3175

Employment type: Permanent, Full time.

Salary Range: $75,000 to $85,000 plus Superannuation.

Key Responsibilities

•	Work closely with customers, engineers, and technical teams to assess equipment needs and recommend suitable products or system solutions.
•	Collaborate with sales teams to assess customer needs and recommend suitable wind energy solutions.
•	Promote the SWB Wind engineering and product capabilities.
•	Provide technical presentations and product demonstrations to prospective clients.
•	Prepare quotations, negotiate pricing, and manage the full sales cycle including order placement, contract negotiation, and delivery coordination.
•	Assist in preparing proposals, bids, projects and responses to RFQs.
•	Provide ongoing technical support and troubleshooting for clients.
•	Conduct routine inspections and maintenance to ensure optimal turbine performance.
•	Train clients and internal teams on operation and maintenance procedures.
•	Schedule jobs in house and with third party suppliers.
•	Control job schedules, timelines and deadlines.
•	Work at assigned Wind Farm or workshop locations as required.
•	Promote and deliver cost effective process, solutions and savings.

To be successful in the role the applicant will need:

•	A relevant bachelor’s degree (required).
•	At least one year of experience in a similar role
•	Strong technical understanding of industrial products, machinery, and mechanical systems.
•	he ability to interpret technical drawings & schematics, and complete detailed inspection & QA reports.
•	The ability to understand and respond effectively to customer needs.
•	Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
•	High level of experience in Microsoft Excel and Word.
•	A proactive, self – motivated, and highly organised with excellent time management skills.
•	A high level of professionalism.
•	Current Driver’s License.
•	Access to a Personal Vehicle for site travel (Essential).

If you are looking to join a supportive work environment where you can grow and become the best version of yourself, apply now and start your career with SWB!

To apply, please click on the “Apply Now” button and submit both your resume and covering letter.

Irrigation Technician
Employer:Rita's Farm Produce Pty Limited
Location: 1204 Mamre Road, Kemps Creek, NSW 2178, Australia
Employment type: Full-time, 38 hours per week
Remuneration: $75,000 - $85,000 

About Rita Farm
Since its establishment in 2001, Rita's Farm Produce Pty Limited has been deeply engaged in Australia's organic agriculture sector for over 20 years. It is a highly reputable certified organic family farm in New South Wales, located at 1204 Mamre Road, Kemps Creek, covering an area of 55 acres. Adhering to strict organic farming standards, the farm consistently upholds the core philosophy of "growing food as medicine" and is committed to providing high-quality organic fruits, vegetables, and baked goods—free of chemical pesticides and synthetic fertilizers—to Sydney, Canberra, and surrounding regions.
We adhere to sustainable agricultural practices and protect biodiversity through ecological balance technologies, having now become a benchmark brand in the local organic agriculture sector. To support the farm's large-scale development and the refined management of its irrigation systems, we are sincerely inviting professional irrigation technicians to join us in jointly safeguarding the core lifeline of organic farming.

Duties & Responsibilities
System Operation & Maintenance Management: Responsible for the daily operation, inspection, maintenance, and troubleshooting of drip/sprinkler irrigation systems (including water pumps, pipelines, etc.), ensuring the precise irrigation needs of 55 acres of organic crops are met.
Irrigation Plan Development: Develop scientific irrigation plans based on organic standards, crop cycles, soil, and climate data. Precisely control water volume and frequency to ensure certification compliance.
Fertigation Integration Operation: Operate relevant equipment to precisely mix organic fertilizers for simultaneous irrigation. Monitor the process and record data to ensure efficient nutrient absorption.
Data Optimization & Review: Establish operation records for irrigation systems, documenting equipment status, test data, etc. Regularly analyze efficiency and propose optimization or upgrade suggestions.
Safety & Collaboration Assurance: Adhere to WHS (Work Health and Safety) standards. Coordinate with the planting team and farm manager to provide irrigation technical support and participate in planting planning meetings.

Selection Criteria / Skills & Qualifications
Possess 1-3 years of relevant experience in irrigation system installation/maintenance, or practical experience in horticultural/agricultural irrigation.
Proficient in the operation and maintenance of core irrigation system components, including pumps, valves, piping, and irrigation controllers, with a solid understanding of water supply scheduling logic.
Have a basic grasp of the principles of hydraulic parameters in agricultural/horticultural settings and an understanding of water resource optimization and management methods.
Adaptable to outdoor working environments, capable of independently completing physical work tasks, and equipped with reliable maintenance execution capabilities.
Demonstrate strong communication and coordination skills, able to effectively collaborate with farm teams and management.
Meticulous and reliable in work, prioritize work safety, strictly comply with labour hire industry standards, and adhere to high-quality craftsmanship requirements.
Flexible to adjust work arrangements in line with the farm’s production cycles.

What We Offer
Competitive salary for a full-time, 38-hour week role.
Stable employment with compliant labour-hire arrangements, including rostered hours, structured workforce management, and professional work conditions aligned with our values of integrity, reliability, and compliance.

More information
For more information, please email(adding company email). To learn more about working with us, we encourage you to visit our website
https://www.ritasfarm.com.au/

SK tes is a global leader in sustainable technology lifecycle services, providing end-to-end IT asset management solutions spanning deployment, decommissioning, reuse and recycling. Operating 40+ owned facilities across more than 20 countries and supporting clients worldwide, SK tes processes and managing large-scale technology assets with a strong focus on security, compliance, and value recovery. Guided by its mission to “securely, safely, and sustainably transform and re-purpose one billion kilograms of assets by 2030,” the organisation leverages innovation and global capability to deliver meaningful outcomes for both clients and the environment.

About the Role

Company: SK tes Pty Ltd
Location: Union Cct YATALA QLD 4207
Job Type: Casual 
Salary/Rate: Award Rates Apply (Paid in accordance with the relevant Modern Award)

Role Overview

An IT Recycle Operator is responsible for the proper disposal and recycling of information technology (IT) equipment that has reached the end of its useful life. The role involves handling electronic waste (e-waste) in an environmentally responsible manner, ensuring compliance with regulations, and promoting sustainable practices. The IT Recycle Operator plays a crucial role in reducing the environmental impact of discarded IT assets and supporting the organization's commitment to responsible recycling. 

An operator will work across a multitude of departments in our production facilities. Operators will be efficient and reliable in processing, organising and packing of assets. 

Where an operator has the necessary licences, training and ability, an operator may be required to operate machinery as directed by their line manager.

Key Accountabilities

•	Be responsible for the quality assurance of their own work.
•	Works under routine supervision, either individually or in a team environment.
•	Being able to lift to 15kg.
•	Complete necessary training materials, a directed by the business.
•	Follow all reasonable directions of the Team Leader.
•	Maintain accurate records and inventory of all disposed assets.
•	Some of the daily work activities include receiving, sorting, testing, warehousing, data destruction, and de-manufacturing.
•	General tasks associated with the receiving and dispatch of assets.
•	Able to maintain records or reports in accordance with company procedures.
•	Operators will rotate and work across a multitude of departments in our production facilities and be efficient and reliable in processing, organising and packing of assets.
•	Perform data sanitization and secure data destruction processes on all retired IT assets to prevent data breaches and ensure compliance with data protection regulations.
•	Safely and responsibly handle the dismantling and disposal of electronic components following proper procedures.
•	Conduct accurate testing and assessment of returned assets to determine their potential for refurbishment or reuse as per the guidelines.
•	Conduct Inventory Stock Take activities.
•	May be directed to perform other duties consistent with training and skill levels required for this position.
•	Maintaining confidentiality and ensuring data security throughout the ITAD process.

Job Requirements & Qualifications

•	Experience in Warehousing (Preferable) 
•	A valid forklift licence is a PLUS but not required
•	Effective communication skills
•	Basic admin/data entry capability
•	Understanding of IT hardware components and familiarity with various types of electronic devices.
•	Physical fitness to handle and move electronic equipment.
•	Ability to operate recycling machinery and equipment safely and efficiently.
•	Strong attention to detail to ensure proper sorting and disposal of e-waste.

What We Offer

•	Competitive remuneration package
•	Career progression opportunities
•	Ongoing training and professional development
•	Supportive and collaborative team environment
•	Opportunity to be part of a growing global organisation focused on sustainability and innovation
